description: ADR-0120 amendment A6 R5a deictic-write corpus (§6.1; schema: docs/plans/a6-deictic-write-proposal.md §6.1, nl-action-corpus-schema.md). Agent-drafted per D12 (owner decision 9, 2026-10-16). Fixture: `turn` (the previous owner message, its eligibility at receipt and the reply kind), `items` (eventLinked, kind BRIEF, origin connector), `lastAction`, `listing`, `replyTo`, `direct`, `switch`, `questionOpen`, `capped`. Outcomes: preview (payload, referent), ask, refuse or chat. Names and titles are invented.
